content.short: Crypto Samurai NFT Collection results from multi-level processing by humans: mix of photography & hand-designed objects.
content.description:
Crypto Samurai is a collection of limited edition NFTs - which consists of 4500 digital collectibles built on the Cardano blockchain. Each Art object is a unique commemorative item that results from multi-level processing by humans, not artificially algorithmic generated objects.

The collection is divided into 7 sets. The sets correspond to the belt grading system stated by the International Karate Organization Kyokushinkaikan and the founder Masutatsu Oyama: White belt, Orange belt, Blue belt, Yellow belt, Green belt, Brown belt, Black belt.

With Crypto Samurai, we tried to create a bridge between Kyokushin & martial arts discipline and blockchain technology. We giving the opportunity to improve the connection between martial arts lovers and sports organizations.

Also, this collection was made to draw crypto public attention to young people's spiritual and healthy education problems. The important goal of creating the NFT Collection was to pay tribute to all Kyokushin masters all over the world.
